title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.67 (quiet) at 01:00 UTC on 4 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 4 日 01:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.67（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 1.67 (2M) at 01:00 UTC on 4 October 2026. The 01:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 01:59; hour-start 1.67/2M, hour-end 2.67/3M). Last-180 maximum is 3.00 (first at 2026-10-04T02:32:00Z; label 3Z). Published-window maximum is 3.00 (first at 2026-10-04T02:32:00Z; label 3Z). Window start 2026-10-03T20:57:00Z (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 02 UTC on 2026-10-04 hour is still incomplete (55 samples through 02:54).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
